description: Master Canonical Candidate A - Heroic frontal vertical (IG/Feed) - real Ecuanutrition palette - retry 3
prompt:
ECUAMAN, official superhero mascot of ECUANUTRITION (Ecuadorian aquaculture brand). Full-body HEROIC FRONTAL vertical pose centered, facing camera, chin up, confident proud smile. Pixar/DreamWorks 3D semi-realistic style, vibrant cinematic underwater lighting.

ANATOMY (Penaeus vannamei whiteleg shrimp anthropomorphized): SINGLE curved orange shrimp body, hex F39A2B base with darker C2691A ventral shadow and FFD27A highlights. SIX clearly defined abdominal segments. Fan caudal tail at the BOTTOM (central pointed telson + 4 lateral uropods opened in fan) - NO human legs, NO boots, the lower body MUST be the curved segmented shrimp tail. Muscular humanoid torso fused with the cefalotorax showing six-pack abs through the orange shell plates. Two muscular bare humanoid arms emerging from the cefalotorax. Right hand holds a tall vertical energy trident with three prongs, the trident core glows in CELESTE FRESCO hex 7CBFF6 with white halo. Left arm flexed, fist closed, showing bicep. Head has serrated rostrum (saw-like top beak with 8 small teeth) and two large round expressive cartoon eyes on short eyestalks, white sclera with round black pupils, friendly warm expression. TWO long thin flexible antennae arching upward longer than body, ending in dual ribbon tassels: one bright RED hex CE1126 and one bright YELLOW hex FFDD00 (Ecuadorian flag colors).

COSTUME (OFFICIAL ECUANUTRITION PALETTE - STRICTLY THESE COLORS):
- Cape: AZUL MARINO hex 295071 (deep navy blue), flowing dramatically backwards, attached at shoulders only, inner lining slightly darker.
- Belt around the waist: AZUL MARINO hex 295071. The text 'ECUAMAN' in bold white Figtree Regular sans-serif capitals is rendered LARGE across the belt.
- One central circular medallion on the belt (THE ONLY MEDALLION IN THE ENTIRE IMAGE): white background hex FFFFFF, thin Azul Marino 295071 ring border, in the center a stylized lowercase letter 'e' in elegant Cormorant Light serif style colored Azul Marino 295071, with a small Celeste Fresco hex 7CBFF6 dot accent on the upper-right corner of the e (this is the official Ecuanutrition isotype - parent brand mark).
- Below the medallion in tiny letter-spaced white caps: 'AQUACULTURE PRODUCTS'.
- Small Coral hex FF6E6E accent line on the belt edge.
NO chest emblem. NO additional medallions. NO royal blue 0046AD anywhere - the cape MUST be the deeper navy 295071.

BACKGROUND: deep Pacific Ocean gradient from Azul Marino 295071 top to a slightly lighter Celeste 7CBFF6 bottom-glow, three soft diagonal sunlight god rays from upper-left, subtle bioluminescent particles, faint coral hex FF6E6E micro-bokeh accents. Cinematic rim light Celeste 7CBFF6 from above, warm key light from front.

Sharp focus, family-friendly, premium B2B aquaculture brand feel.
